purpose: Prospectively test whether source-compatible NQC attachment sampling converges from factor 256 to factor 512 on one fixed factor-512 fine trajectory, with the stationary peak held or recomputed.
interpretation: This controls only attachment sampling with the trajectory held fixed. Independently integrated waveform convergence, historical fidelity, wider parameter domain, NR accuracy, Torch/JAX parity, and ROM qualification remain separate gates.
